title: Notifications
description: Stay informed about messages and important changes concerning your child.
tenantDisabled: Your school has currently disabled notifications. Your selection will be saved and will apply when the school enables them again.

parent_announcement.label: New school announcement
parent_announcement.description: When the school publishes a new announcement in the parent portal.

parent_message.label: New message from the {careTerm}
parent_message.description: When the {careTerm} writes to you about a child.

parent_appointment.label: New or changed appointment
parent_appointment.description: When an appointment for you is created, changed or cancelled.

parent_appointment_reminder.label: Appointment reminder
parent_appointment_reminder.description: Shortly before an appointment to which you are invited.

parent_request_decided.label: Decision on your request
parent_request_decided.description: When the {careTerm} has decided on one of your requests.

parent_care_cancelled.label: Care cancelled
parent_care_cancelled.description: When the {careTerm} cancels one of your child's care sessions.

parent_billing_document.label: New document from the provider
parent_billing_document.description: When the provider sends or shares a document with you, for example a contract.

enableAllTooltip: Turns on all notifications at once.
disableAllTooltip: Turns off all moto notifications for you at once.
